title: RNA Design via Conditioned Flow Matching and Finite-Policy Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36885v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: RNA design aims to identify sequences that fold into specified secondary structures. Existing methods formulate the task as target-specific search or conditional generation. However, natural RNA evolution proceeds through sequence variation and selection, with compensatory substitutions, whereas these methods do not explicitly model this process. To address this limitation, we propose a two-stage framework comprising RNA Inverse-Folding Flow (RNA-IFlow) and RNA-IFlow-RL. RNA-IFlow uses structure-conditioned Dirichlet Flow Matching to model coordinated variation across the sequence, while RNA-IFlow-RL maps the learned flow to a pairing-preserving finite policy and refines it with thermodynamic feedback. Our framework achieves leading performance on multiple benchmarks, reaching 85.19% Pass@1 on Rfam-27. Further analyses reveal thermodynamic gains, policy dynamics, and robustness across settings. translated_title: 基于条件流匹配与有限策略强化学习的RNA设计
translated_abstract: RNA设计旨在识别能够折叠成特定二级结构的序列。现有方法将该任务表述为针对特定目标的搜索或条件生成。然而，自然RNA进化是通过序列变异和选择进行的，并伴随补偿性替换，而这些方法并未显式建模这一过程。为解决这一局限，我们提出了一个两阶段框架，包括RNA逆折叠流和RNA-IFlow-RL。RNA-IFlow使用结构条件化的狄利克雷流匹配来建模序列上的协调变异，而RNA-IFlow-RL将学习到的流映射为保持碱基配对的有限策略，并通过热力学反馈对其进行优化。我们的框架在多个基准测试中取得了领先性能，在Rfam-27上达到85.19%的Pass@1。进一步的分析揭示了热力学增益、策略动态变化以及在不同设置下的鲁棒性。我们的工作将协调变异与（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出结合结构条件化狄利克雷流匹配与保持碱基配对的有限策略强化学习的两阶段RNA逆折叠框架，通过显式建模自然RNA进化中的协调序列变异并利用热力学反馈优化，在多个基准测试中取得领先性能（Rfam-27上Pass@1达85.19%）。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage RNA inverse folding framework combining structure-conditioned Dirichlet flow matching with pairing-preserving finite-policy reinforcement learning, explicitly modeling coordinated sequence variation as in natural RNA evolution and achieving state-of-the-art performance (85.19% Pass@1 on Rfam-27) with thermodynamic feedback refinement.
